name: Bhunu
role: Paramount chief of Swaziland from 1895 to 1899
contribution: The King of Swaziland from 1895 until his death on 10 December 1899.

checks.lead: Bhunu (reigned as Ngwane V; also known as Mahlokohla or Hhili; 11 May 1876 – 10 December 1899) was the King of Swaziland from 1895 until his death on 10 December 1899. He was a son of King Mbandzeni with Queen Labotsibeni Mdluli. He ascended to the throne after a short regency of Queen Mother Labotsibeni after his father died.
